rationale: P characterises whether braking is required and whether that required behaviour occurs in time, directly supporting evaluation of SG-1. H-1's failure-to-stop-in-time event and FR-7's collision-avoidance braking requirement establish braking execution and its timeliness as part of the phenomenon itself. The scope mentions detection and decision-making as context without incorporating their internal mechanisms or processing latencies into P.
determining_elements: “Whether a braking maneuver is required” identifies the condition necessary to evaluate omission of required braking under SG-1.
“Whether braking is performed in time to avoid collision” includes response behaviour legitimately required by SG-1 and FR-7, with temporal relevance established by H-1.
Obstacle encounters involving road users or obstacles in or close to the vehicle's trajectory are supported by H-1 and FR-7.2.4.
The declared scope does not make sensor operation, computation, communication, or detection latency independent subjects of characterisation.
